en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large, continuous block of multi‑storey residential buildings with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows. The block forms a gentle curve along a street, with several arched entrances and shopfronts on the ground floor. In the foreground is an empty, ploughed field or open ground. On the far right edge stands a round corner tower with a conical roof attached to the last building. At the top of the card, printed captions read "Riesa a. Elbe" on the left and "Sedanstraße" on the right.
